mapper.sql: SELECT tt.id, tt.course_id, tt.semester_id, tt.cid, tt.tid, tt.status, tt.create_time, c.name AS course_name, c.credit, sem.name AS semester_name, cl.name AS clazz_name, t.name AS teacher_name FROM teach_task tt LEFT JOIN course c ON tt.course_id = c.course_id LEFT JOIN semester sem ON sem.id = tt.semester_id LEFT JOIN clazz cl ON tt.cid = cl.cid LEFT JOIN teacher t ON tt.tid = t.tid
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO teach_task (course_id, semester_id, cid, tid, status) VALUES (#{courseId}, #{semesterId}, #{cid}, #{tid}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE teach_task SET tid = #{tid} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE teach_task SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: WHERE tt.status = 0 ORDER BY tt.id DESC
